papers.title: Stochastic Multiple Choice Learning for Training Diverse Deep Ensembles
papers.abstract: Many practical perception systems exist within larger processes that include interactions with users or additional components capable of evaluating the quality of predicted solutions. In these contexts, it is beneficial to provide these oracle mechanisms with multiple highly likely hypotheses rather than a single prediction. In this work, we pose the task of producing multiple outputs as a learning problem over an ensemble of deep networks -- introducing a novel stochastic gradient descent based approach to minimize the loss with respect to an oracle. Our method is simple to implement, agnostic to both architecture and loss function, and parameter-free. Our approach achieves lower oracle error compared to existing methods on a wide range of tasks and deep architectures. We also show qualitatively that the diverse solutions produced often provide interpretable representations of task ambiguity.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文不涉及有限元代理建模、生物力学或植入物设计，与用户研究方向无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper presents a general method for training diverse deep ensembles, but does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification for expensive simulations, or any biomechanical/implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升多输出预测场景的多样性，为下游模块提供多个高置信度假设。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于随机梯度下降的深度集成训练方法，通过带oracle的最小化loss生成多样结果。
summary_zh.result: 在多个任务和架构上实现更低的oracle误差，且无需额外参数。
summary_zh.validation: 在图像分类和UCI数据集上实验验证，与多种baseline对比。

summary_en.motivation: To enable systems with downstream evaluation to benefit from multiple diverse high-likelihood predictions rather than a single output.
summary_en.method: A stochastic gradient descent approach is introduced to train an ensemble of deep networks by minimizing the loss with respect to an oracle, promoting diversity.
summary_en.result: The method achieves lower oracle error than prior methods on diverse tasks and architectures, producing interpretable diverse solutions.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation is performed on image classification and UCI datasets, comparing against multiple existing ensemble techniques.

llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure for stiffness matching, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration, which are core to the biomedical implant direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备316L不锈钢的微观结构与断裂行为。
summary_zh.method: 使用SEM、EBSD和拉伸/冲击测试表征不同工艺参数下的微观组织和断裂机理。
summary_zh.result: 发现工艺参数影响晶粒形态和缺陷，断裂模式呈现韧性-脆性混合特征。
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观结构观察与力学测试对比验证断裂机制。

summary_en.motivation: Motivates tailoring SLM parameters to achieve desired mechanical properties through understanding fracture mechanisms.
summary_en.method: Microstructural characterization using SEM and EBSD combined with tensile and impact testing to correlate processing with fracture behavior.
summary_en.result: Identified that processing parameters influence grain morphology and defects, leading to mixed ductile-brittle fracture modes.
summary_en.validation: Validation through microscopy and mechanical testing correlation.

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the clinical and radiographic outcomes of transverse subtrochanteric osteotomy in total hip arthroplasty for developmental dysplasia of the hip.
summary_en.method: A retrospective review of patients who underwent this surgical technique, assessing complications, leg length discrepancy, and cup orientation.
summary_en.result: The technique effectively restored leg length and improved acetabular coverage with acceptable complication rates.
summary_en.validation: Validation based on postoperative clinical follow-up and radiographic measurements.

papers.title: Біомеханічне обґрунтування методики ущільнення стінок кульшової западини під час ендопротезування в умовах остеопорозу
papers.abstract: Osteoporosis worsens the qualitative and quantitative characteristics of bone, which is a hostile environment for the stable long-fixation of acetabular component in hip joint endoprosthesis. Despite the large number of biomechanical studies of the stress-strain distribution in the acetabular component after hip arthroplasty, fixation of cup under osteoporotic conditions remains controversial and not studied well. Object: biomechanical reasoning for methods of acetabular wall augmentation during hip joint arthroplasty under the conditions of osteoporosis.Methods: in thisstudyfinite element method has been used. Pelvis and hip joint simulation in the different walking phases after total hip arthroplasty has been performed. We consider three phases for two cases of arthroplasty. The work is a continuation of earlier research conducted on a mathematical model of the pelvis, which made some changes. Simulation of left hip joint arthroplasty with endoprosthesis «Zimmer» with polyethylene liner. Bone density characteristic of the acetabular part has been changed as for osteoporosis. Also for the second option in osteoporotic acetabular zone cylindrical shape autotransplantats with a diameter of 6 mm and a length of 6 to 13 mm modeled. Results revealed that level of stress-strain state of the acetabulum in all phases of walking increases after arthroplasty in terms of osteoporosis as compared to normal model and in the case of walls augmentation using autotransplantat it is reduced. Conclusion:it has been proved the feasibility of bone autotransplantat using for acetabular walls augmentation during hip joint arthroplasty.

summary_en.motivation: To provide biomechanical reasoning for acetabular wall augmentation during hip arthroplasty under osteoporotic conditions.
summary_en.method: Finite element simulation of the pelvis and hip joint during different walking phases after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.result: Bone autografts reduced the stress-strain state in the osteoporotic acetabulum.
